entries.name: 1000 Needles
entries.description: Deal 1,000 damage to one foe.

entries.name: Achilles
entries.description: Render one foe vulnerable to an additional element.

entries.name: Addle
entries.description: Lowers magick power.

entries.name: Aegis Step
entries.description: Defensive repositioning move inspired by shield-and-bow combat. Grants brief evasion and block focus.

entries.name: Arcane Guard
entries.description: Reduces magickal damage taken for 2 turns.

entries.name: Arsenal Quip
entries.description: Temporarily copy or manifest the weapon of an owned summon for 7 minutes. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

entries.name: Aurora
entries.description: Apply a regeneration effect to self or one ally.

entries.name: Baleful Echo
entries.description: Recasts the last spell with halved MP cost, but with a chance to misfire or backfire.

entries.name: Black Box Revival
entries.description: If the user would be knocked unconscious or killed, one active summon may sacrifice itself to prevent the final blow. Cooldown: 1 week.

entries.name: Blasting Zone
entries.description: Fire a concentrated aether blast from the gunblade for heavy damage.

entries.name: Blink Step
entries.description: Evade next attack and reposition instantly.

entries.name: Blitz
entries.description: Deal physical damage to targets in range.

entries.name: Bloodfest
entries.description: Instantly load Powder Cartridges for burst damage windows.

entries.name: Bonecrusher
entries.description: Consume HP to reduce the HP of one foe to 0.

entries.name: Bow Shock
entries.description: Release an explosive shockwave that damages enemies over time.

entries.name: Brutal Shell
entries.description: Follow Keen Edge with a guarded blast, dealing damage and granting a small barrier.

entries.name: Burst Strike
entries.description: Spend one Powder Cartridge to deliver a heavy gunblade explosion.

entries.name: Camouflage
entries.description: Increase evasion and reduce incoming physical damage for several turns.

entries.name: Challenge
entries.description: Force a single enemy to attack you for a short time.

entries.name: Charge
entries.description: Restores MP but may fail.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: Cause one foe to Confuse friend with foe.

entries.name: Continuation
entries.description: Follow certain cartridge attacks with an extra precision blast.

entries.name: Corpse Relay
entries.description: Use an active summon as a battlefield relay point for targeting, pressure, and tactical awareness.

entries.name: Counterblow
entries.description: Take an enemy attack and return it upon the attacker as physical damage.

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.description: Take an enemy attack and return it upon the attacker as magick damage.

entries.name: Cover
entries.description: Intercept damage meant for one ally.

entries.name: Cover Breach
entries.description: Overload deployed cover to create pushback, smoke, stagger, or heated shrapnel.

entries.name: Covering Fire
entries.description: Allies gain Dodge advantage; interrupts enemy charges.

entries.name: Dead Man's Trigger
entries.description: When a Loyal Summon is destroyed, it may perform one final action before vanishing.

entries.name: Deathblow
entries.description: Attempt to instantly slay a target at low HP.

entries.name: Demon Slaughter
entries.description: Finish the area combo and load one Powder Cartridge.

entries.name: Demon Slice
entries.description: Perform a sweeping gunblade strike against multiple enemies.

entries.name: Despair Gaze
entries.description: Inflicts Fear and causes target to randomly skip turns.

entries.name: Double Down
entries.description: Spend two Powder Cartridges to unleash a devastating point-blank detonation.

entries.name: Echo Mark
entries.description: Mark one enemy, improving summon tracking and granting a small bonus to Extraction if the marked target dies.

entries.name: Elude
entries.description: Defend with a high probability of evading enemy attacks.

entries.name: Entrench
entries.description: Defend and prepare a counterattack, dealing more damage the longer you defend.

entries.name: Erasure
entries.description: Nullifies all active buffs on one enemy, including barrier, regen, and reflect effects.

entries.name: Evade
entries.description: Attempt to evade enemy attacks. Certain attacks cannot be evaded.

entries.name: Expose
entries.description: Lower one foe's defense.

entries.name: Extraction
entries.description: When an enemy or NPC is dead, the user gains three D100 attempts to bind the corpse as a Loyal Summon. Cooldown is 1-2 weeks depending on summon size and DM approval.

entries.name: First Aid
entries.description: Works on a living ally below 15% HP; restores a random 0–20% of maximum HP.

entries.name: Foresight
entries.description: Reveal the target’s intended action next turn, increasing evasion.

entries.name: Gil Toss
entries.description: Throw gil to damage all foes in range.

entries.name: Gnashing Fang
entries.description: Spend one Powder Cartridge to begin a brutal three-part gunblade chain.

entries.name: Gravebound Reload
entries.description: Reload or recharge one firearm by drawing residual energy from a corpse, destroyed summon, or battlefield remnant.

entries.name: Guard
entries.description: Reduces physical and magick damage taken from enemy attacks while guarding.

entries.name: Guard Counter
entries.description: Enter a guarding stance, then retaliate after blocking a hit.

entries.name: Heart of Corundum
entries.description: Upgrade Heart of Stone with stronger mitigation and emergency healing.

entries.name: Heart of Light
entries.description: Reduce magical damage taken by the party for several turns.

entries.name: Heart of Stone
entries.description: Grant a defensive barrier to self or one ally.

entries.name: Heavy Guard
entries.description: Greatly reduces physical and magick damage taken while guarding, but at a higher ATB cost.

entries.name: Heroic Guard
entries.description: Massively reduces physical and magick damage taken while guarding, but at a very high ATB cost.

entries.name: Highwind
entries.description: Release a catastrophic jump strike, clearing chain gauges. Damage varies by situation.

entries.name: Hollowpoint Round
entries.description: Fires armor-piercing shot. Ignores partial Defense.

entries.name: Horology
entries.description: Deals time-based damage.

entries.name: Infuse
entries.description: Fully consume user's MP, changing one ally's HP to 10 times that amount.

entries.name: Keen Edge
entries.description: Strike with the opening cut of the gunblade combo.

entries.name: Launch
entries.description: Attack and launch a staggered target into the air.

entries.name: Libra
entries.description: Reveal detailed information about targets.

entries.name: Libra II
entries.description: Reveal detailed information about Chaos Inflicted targets.

entries.name: Light Guard
entries.description: Slightly reduces physical and magick damage taken while guarding. Low ATB cost.

entries.name: Magick Counter
entries.description: Chance to counter with a random spell when hit by magick.

entries.name: Mediguard
entries.description: Defend while gradually recovering HP.

entries.name: Nebula
entries.description: Greatly reduce incoming damage for a short time.

entries.name: NulAll Guard
entries.description: Reduces damage taken while guarding and greatly reduces elemental-attribute damage.

entries.name: Numerology
entries.description: Damage increases with hits.

entries.name: Poach
entries.description: Capture weakened foes for loot.

entries.name: Power Focus
entries.description: Increases next magick's power by 50%.

entries.name: Provoke
entries.description: Entices enemies to attack you instead of allies.

entries.name: Revive
entries.description: Fully consume user's HP, reviving and fully restoring HP of one KO'd ally.

entries.name: Royal Guard
entries.description: Assume a tank stance, increasing threat generated and improving defensive posture.

entries.name: Ruin
entries.description: Deal non-elemental magick damage to one target.

entries.name: Ruinga
entries.description: Deal non-elemental magick damage to targets within a wide radius.

entries.name: Savage Claw
entries.description: Second strike of the Gnashing Fang chain.

entries.name: Shades of Black
entries.description: Cast a random black magick on one foe.

entries.name: Shadow Dance
entries.description: Swap places with an owned active summon. Cooldown: 50 seconds.

entries.name: Shear
entries.description: Lowers magick resistance.

entries.name: Sight Unseeing
entries.description: Unleash an attack only available when blind.

entries.name: Smite
entries.description: Deal heavy damage to a launched target about to recover from stagger.

entries.name: Solid Barrel
entries.description: Complete the core combo and load one Powder Cartridge.

entries.name: Souleater
entries.description: Consume HP to deal damage to one foe.

entries.name: Soulshred
entries.description: Deals high non-elemental damage and reduces MP of target based on caster's missing HP.

entries.name: Sovereign Fist
entries.description: Crush foes with a ruinous blow, clearing chain gauges. Damage varies by situation.

entries.name: Spellblade
entries.description: Imbue weapon with a selected element for 3 turns.

entries.name: Stamp
entries.description: Transfers status effects.

entries.name: Steal
entries.description: Steal from one foe.

entries.name: Steelguard
entries.description: Reduces damage taken while guarding. Guard becomes more effective each time damage is taken.

entries.name: Summon Fusion
entries.description: Temporarily resonate with an owned Loyal Summon to use part of that summon’s abilities. Cooldown: at least 4 days.

entries.name: Superbolide
entries.description: Drop to critical HP to become nearly immune to damage for a short duration.

entries.name: Suppressive Burst
entries.description: Reduces enemy movement and disables reactions for 1 turn.

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.description: Allow melee weapons to hit distant targets.

entries.name: Traveler
entries.description: deals fixed damage to an enemy and enemies in range in its vicinity based on the number of steps currently taken. After being used, or after 1000 steps, the counter resets..

entries.name: Trick Reload
entries.description: Reloads and dodges simultaneously. Grants temporary Evasion.

entries.name: Vein Tap
entries.description: Restores MP equal to the number of active illusions when cast.

entries.name: Vendetta
entries.description: Counterattack after defending, dealing more damage the more you are attacked.

entries.name: Vital Shot
entries.description: Target weak point to deal bonus damage and apply Bleed.

entries.name: Wicked Talon
entries.description: Final strike of the Gnashing Fang chain.

entries.name: Wither
entries.description: Lower one foe's strength.
